## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: review-findings-schema.md defines verification_evidence: {command: string, output: string} as sibling of cited_excerpt, with schema validation requiring the field on absence-language findings
- DD2: Enforcement operates in soft-deprecation mode by default; hard rejection activates only when sentinel file is present
- DD3: Plugin cache version marker name, location, and detection logic are documented

## What
Update `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md` to:

### 1. Add `verification_evidence` field to the Field Definitions table
Add after `cited_excerpt` row:
```
| `verification_evidence` | object | Conditional | Required on findings whose `description` matches any pattern in `absence-claim-anchors.json`. Object with two required string fields: `command` (the shell command run to verify absence) and `output` (the verbatim command output confirming absence). Absent findings are warned (soft mode) or rejected (hard mode) per enforcement sentinel. |
```

Also add to the `## Signal Format` JSON example:
```json
{
  "cited_excerpt": "some code excerpt here",
  "verification_evidence": {
    "command": "ls -la path/to/file.py",
    "output": "ls: path/to/file.py: No such file or directory"
  }
}
```

### 2. Add new section `## Absence-Claim Enforcement`
Document:
- **Absence-claim detection**: findings whose `description` field matches any phrase in `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/absence-claim-anchors.json` (`anchors` array = exact substring match; `anchors_prefix_patterns` array = regex prefix match) are tagged as absence claims requiring `verification_evidence`.
- **Soft-deprecation mode (default)**: when the sentinel file is absent, validators WARN but do not reject. Warning format: `"WARNING: finding[N].verification_evidence absent on absence-claim finding (soft mode — upgrade to strict with sentinel file)"`.
- **Hard enforcement mode**: activated when the file `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/contracts/absence-claim-enforcement-v1` exists. Validators REJECT findings with a missing `verification_evidence` field. Exit code 1. Error format: `"finding[N]: missing required field 'verification_evidence' (absence claim detected: '<matched_phrase>')"`.
- **Sentinel file documentation**:
  - Name: `absence-claim-enforcement-v1`
  - Path: `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/contracts/absence-claim-enforcement-v1`
  - Detection: file-existence check via `os.path.exists` in the validator
  - Created by: the DSO plugin package when the version introducing hard enforcement is installed
  - Manual creation: `touch "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/contracts/absence-claim-enforcement-v1"` (for users who want to opt into hard enforcement immediately)
- **Anchor list source**: `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/absence-claim-anchors.json` (see `absence-claim-anchors.md` for documentation)
- **For S2 testing**: S2 behavioral fixtures must assert which enforcement mode is active by checking whether the sentinel file is present before running hard-mode test scenarios.

### 3. Update Consumers table
Add validator entry: `validate-review-output.sh` → Parser → Enforces `verification_evidence` conditional requirement.

### 4. Add Change Log entry
```
- **2026-05-14**: Added `verification_evidence: {command, output}` field (S1). Absence-claim detection via `absence-claim-anchors.json` pattern set. Soft-deprecation mode by default; hard enforcement via `absence-claim-enforcement-v1` sentinel file.
```

## DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION
Gate 2 fired: this task updates an existing reference contract doc (`review-findings-schema.md`).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>&1; echo "lint ok"
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>&1; echo "format ok"
- [ ] verification_evidence field definition added to review-findings-schema.md
  Verify: grep -q "verification_evidence" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md
- [ ] Sentinel file path documented (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/contracts/absence-claim-enforcement-v1)
  Verify: grep -q "absence-claim-enforcement-v1" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md
- [ ] Soft-deprecation mode behavior documented (warn not reject by default)
  Verify: grep -q "soft" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md && grep -q "hard" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md
- [ ] Change log entry added with correct date
  Verify: grep -q "2026-05-14" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Extend review-findings-schema.md with verification_evidence field, enforcement mode, and sentinel file documentation
